text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: A whole week of rest, huh… What was I thinking, letting myself get hurt like this?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I knew I was exhausted, but I was worried I'd fall behind if I didn't train more, and I just…

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Oh, but don't worry—I can still do some training! I'm pretty sure the doctor was blowing this whole thing out of proportion.
choice_data_list: I'd rather you rest for now.
A sturdy mindset can overcome any injury!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: But I already train less than everyone else because of my modeling job…

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: If I have to sit around and rest, I'm literally going to go insane!
choice_data_list: I'll work out a special training regimen for after you've recovered.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Ugh… It's frustrating, but I understand. I'll talk to my manager about my schedule too.
And so, Gold City is forced to take some time off.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Whoa. Why are you so fired up all of a sudden? I mean… it's not that I don't understand.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Can't let an injury slow us down. We've got to get back to the track and—
choice_data_list: Take it slow though! Or else you'll—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: No way… It hurts just to walk. I can't train properly like this…

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Am I supposed to just sit here and do nothing?
Although the reality disheartens her, I tell Gold City her priority is to recover from her injury.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Can't let an injury slow us down. We've got to get—
choice_data_list: —back to the infirmary and have a strategy meeting.
—back to the infirmary and have a strategy meeting.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: What happened to overcoming my injury with a sturdy mindset?!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: No, wait… I'm sorry. I'm being careless. It's important to consider how I go about recovering, right?
After that, the two of us work out a training regimen she can perform while injured. It might be a light load, but it'll still contribute toward her progress.
